findings.title: DSA-2026-451: Security Update for Dell Enterprise SONiC Distribution Vulnerabilities
findings.summary_md: NotCVE indexes Dell PSIRT advisory DSA-2026-451, titled Security Update for Dell Enterprise SONiC Distribution Vulnerabilities, with a publication date of 2026-11-19. The mirror lists CVE-2026-103782 and CVE-2026-103788 among the advisory identifiers and reports a highest CVSS of 9.9. Its automated summary counts 791 CVEs and 72 critical entries across the advisory set, with three CISA KEV entries and a top EPSS of 17.2%.

findings.title: CVE Record: CVE-2026-103782
findings.summary_md: The Dell-assigned CVE record says Enterprise Sonic Distribution versions before 4.6.1 contain an argument injection flaw, CWE-88, that a low-privileged remote attacker could use for arbitrary command execution and unauthorized access to filesystem resources. It scores CVSS v3.1 9.9 with vector AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H. Dell set datePublic to 2026-11-19T15:46:00Z, and CISA's ADP entry records exploitation as none.

findings.title: CVE Record: CVE-2026-103788
findings.summary_md: The Dell-assigned CVE record says Enterprise Sonic Distribution versions before 4.6.1 contain an OS command injection flaw, CWE-78, exploitable by an unauthenticated adjacent-network attacker for arbitrary command execution. It scores CVSS v3.1 9.6 with vector AV:A/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H and was considered critical by Dell because it may allow unauthenticated command execution. Dell set datePublic to 2026-11-19T16:15:00Z.

findings.title: GHSA-xc45-p8rw-97h8: Dell Enterprise Sonic Distribution argument injection
findings.summary_md: GitHub's advisory mirrors Dell's description of CVE-2026-103782 and rates it critical. It points to NVD and Dell advisory DSA-2026-451 as references and lists no credits. The advisory was published on 2026-11-23T18:31:50Z.

findings.title: GHSA-36xc-v4gh-3gmr: Dell Enterprise Sonic Distribution OS command injection
findings.summary_md: GitHub's advisory mirrors Dell's description of CVE-2026-103788 and rates it critical. It repeats that an unauthenticated adjacent-network attacker could execute arbitrary commands on versions before 4.6.1. It references NVD and Dell advisory DSA-2026-451 and lists no credits.
